name: Oni Quake

card.plain: Slam the club into the ground; the shock hits low.
Lv 1 → Lv 2: Oni Quake recovers 4 frames faster, so a blocked slam costs less.
A second quake shakes the ground 30 frames after the first.

notes: Clip oni-quake (56 frames via retime curve, hit 28-31): 27/4/25. Delta against the rules.md table 22/5/26: +5 startup, -1 active, -1 recovery; clip timing kept (F2), flagged for the designer (the held overhead tell is 4 frames of the 27). Hits low (C3, properties.low): a ground-level box x 110-310, y 0-110 in front of the club, since the slam's shock is the hit, not the club head. Input slot D (down / 22) is proposed: rules.md names no slot for Oni's specials. Locked: marked with the diamond (A11). Lv 2 recovery -4 is proposed (one tuning step, A4), chosen for the Oni's rushdown identity; the designer decides. Lv 3 properties.aftershock_delay is a new engine key (not in the frame-data schema); the second quake repeats the Lv-current hitbox and is data-only (A5); needs gameplay-programmer support. No EX written: its numbers are an open question. Damage 90 is the table; hitstun and blockstun are placeholders.
